summary: An NSE index in Quote mode: the index frame carries LTP, OHLC, the previous close and the change worked out from them.

deviations.reason: This web adapter puts the subscription mode number in data.mode (mstock_adapter.py:202); the desktop sends the label (ltp, quote, full). data.mode follows the web adapter in Phase B through lane wire's per-broker switch in the dialect table, set for mStock (integer).
The web also sends mStock's exchange timestamp under its own name whenever the packet carries one (mstock_adapter.py:357-358); the desktop's common carrier has no such field, so it is lost.
deviations.ref: audit C06; WEBSOCKET_AUDIT_REMAINING_BROKERS.md 'Verified broker fields dropped' (mstock)

deviations.reason: The web sends the previous close twice, as close and as prev_close (mstock_adapter.py:366-367); the desktop sends close only, and its dialect table has no prev_close alias for mStock.

mStock's Quote packet (123 bytes) carries no open interest; the web sends oi 0 for it (mstock_adapter.py:369, quote_data.get('oi', 0) with the parser's oi: 0 placeholder, mstockwebsocket.py:211), an invented zero a client reads as a real OI. The desktop leaves oi out of a frame whose packet has none, and sends the real OI from a full packet.
deviations.ref: docs/api/websocket-streaming/quote.md (a field the broker does not carry is left out); web openalgo#2376

The index shape follows the web adapter in Phase B through lane wire's per-broker switch in the dialect table, set for mStock.

The desktop sends price_change and price_change_percent in an index frame, worked out from the LTP and the previous close (100.75 and 0.42 here); this web adapter sends no change for an index (mstock_adapter.py:340-433). The index change follows the web adapter in Phase B through lane wire's per-broker switch in the dialect table, set for mStock (C04 decides the change fields for every instrument).
